items.rationale: Sections 2.3.3, 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) make the police report a condition of cover but exclude the cost of translating it. The conditional estimate is 68 lines × €2.50.
Sections 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the provider’s working materials and any surcharge attached to the excluded translation. The conditional estimate is €10 for the single charge.

items.description: Robbery loss: Tudor watch and cash
items.rationale: The reported robbery is covered under §§2.3 and 11.1; the pictured Tudor Royal day-date watch is estimated to reach the €2,500 unscheduled valuables cap, and the cash loss exceeds the €500 cash cap. The €5,000 away-from-home limit does not bind, so the estimate is €2,500 + €500 − the single €50 deductible = €2,950, subject to the itemisation required by §7.1.10.
Sections 5.2.3 and 7.1.8(b) exclude forwarding charges even when they appear on the covered property settlement statement. The conditional estimate is 1 × €26 from the shipping prior.
